newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RUGBY UNION-GAUTENG LIONS BEAT NEW SOUTH WALES 36-27.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-GAUTENG LIONS BEAT NEW SOUTH WALES 36-27.

text.p: Gauteng Lions (formerly known as Transvaal) beat New South Wales 36-27 (halftime 26-13) in their Super 12 rugby union match at Ellis Park on Saturday.
Gauteng Lions: Tries - Kobus Wiese, Gavin Johnson, Johan Roux. Conversions - Johnson (3). Penalties - Johnson (5)
New South Wales: Tries - Alistair Murdoch, Fili Finau, Stuart Pinkerton. Conversions - Matthew Burke (3). Penalties - Burke (2).
